primarySources.meaning: Includes the domain-split SystemInfo protocol file.
ProcessInfo contains string type, integer id and number cpuTime; cumulative CPU seconds since process start across all threads. Command returns processInfo array.
CPU query failure is replaced with zero TimeDelta before InSecondsF; browser/valid renderer/valid child processes are enumerated sequentially. Browser target only.
Internal CPU usage reports errors separately; cumulative CPU includes all threads and can exceed elapsed wall time on multiple cores.
Windows may use calibrated QueryProcessCycleTime/TSC or kernel+user GetProcessTimes. Handle duplication may fail. Local branch and precision not measured.
For another process, TotalProcessorTime uses GetProcessTimes; invalid handle or failed native call throws instead of returning false zero.

currentMethod.positiveRule: Nonempty unique valid PID sets with identical PID/type identity and finite positive cumulative counters at both endpoints, no reset, finite sum/ratio.

currentMethod.cpuToWallRatio: Observed summed CPU seconds divided by actual caller monotonic wallMilliseconds/1000; may exceed1 across threads.
currentMethod.sharedEndpointScope: Same two browser-level endpoints on/off around trace setup and closed collection window, before tail/drain. Recorded Node monotonic interval, not literal600s.
